archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY + SWISS ELEGANCE (Islamic Premium Travel)
emotional_tone: Elegant, Trustworthy, Premium, Warm, Serene, Professional, Modern

theme_strategy.description: Clean, light & airy aesthetic with rich Biru Tosca (#0F766E), deep navy contrast (#0F172A), warm gold accents (#D97706), and bone-cream background fills (#F8FAF9). Avoid standard full-screen gradients and heavy decorative repeating arabesque lattices; rely on geometry, crisp shadows, elegant serif headers, and subtle metallic gold borders.

scale.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
scale.caption: text-xs font-sans uppercase tracking-widest text-teal-800 font-semibold

spacing_and_layout.grid_mode: Tetris Asymmetric for marketing, High Density for Admin Dashboard

key_components_mapping.navbar: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 z-50 with Biru Tosca brand accent, links: Beranda, Paket (Umrah, Haji, Wisata), Pembimbing, Tentang Kami, Artikel, Kontak, + Admin Login CTA
key_components_mapping.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom right corner button (bottom-6 right-6 z-50) with pulsing status ring and direct prefilled chat trigger
key_components_mapping.package_card: Includes status badge, price tag in Rupiah, duration pill, departure date, Garuda flight logo/badge, remaining seat quota progress bar, and 'Detail Paket' & 'Daftar Paket' CTAs
key_components_mapping.package_detail_page: Hero flyer showcase, package title, status badge, pricing banner, departure details (garuda flights, BTJ-JED), Hotel Makkah/Madinah stars, Pembimbing/Tokoh card with quote, detailed day-by-day Itinerary accordion, included/excluded checklist, photo gallery, FAQ, and sticky bottom booking drawer
key_components_mapping.public_registration_modal: Form with name, gender, phone/WhatsApp, address, email. On submit shows confirmation screen with direct WhatsApp follow-up button containing prefilled message
key_components_mapping.admin_dashboard: Enterprise grade travel management system with KPI cards, Recharts visualization, data tables with search/filter/export CSV, package builder, Jamaah customer records, and CMS content editor

testing_attributes.format: kebab-case data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tables, modals, tabs)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use standard JS/JSX syntax compatible with Create React App setup.
Import UI primitives from src/components/ui/ directory (button, card, dialog, tabs, dropdown-menu, sheet, table, etc.).
Always apply data-testid attribute to interactive buttons, links, inputs, and modals.
Implement CMS state cleanly so Admin edits immediately affect the public website views.
Ensure natural Indonesian phrasing throughout the copy (e.g. 'Teman Perjalanan Menuju Tanah Suci', 'Konsultasi WhatsApp', 'Daftar Paket').
